criteria: Festivals, customs, religion, cuisine, clothing, languages and naming, arts, occupations, social conventions, daily life.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Lantern Rite Festival
items.notes: Liyue's New Year-style festival ending with Xiao lanterns; recurring annual flagship event (first playable 1.3).

items.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
items.wiki: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
items.notes: Natlan's tournament ritual feeding the Sacred Flame; winners fight the Night Warden Wars vs. the Abyss (Ancient Name holders only; Ode of Resurrection). Suspended by Mavuika after Kachina's case. May overlap lore scope (Sacred Flame, Night Warden Wars).

items.name: Windblume Festival
items.notes: Mondstadt's signature festival; gift-giving of windblumes, celebrates freedom and Barbatos / Vennessa's revolt.

items.name: Religion in Fontaine
items.notes: Worship of the Hydro Archon (Egeria, then Focalors/Furina), Prophecy of Fontaine, the Oratrice and trials as divine justice; Furina's birthday remains a public holiday after her abdication.

items.name: Trials as Spectacle in Fontaine
items.notes: Public trials at the Opera Epiclese as theatre; Champion Duelists; complex law. Overlaps location/item (Oratrice) entries.

items.name: Fontinalia Festival
items.notes: Commemorates the Lochknights' search for the Oceanids and Egeria's welcome; includes Fontinalia Film Festival ('Furina Award'). Also recurs in 'Sunny Summer Fontinalia' (Luna VIII / 6.7).

items.name: Religion in Inazuma
items.notes: Shogunate islands worship the Shogun (Grand Narukami Shrine, shrine maidens, Sacred Sakura); Watatsumi worships Orobashi; historic Tsurumi Thunderbird (Kanna Kapatcir) cult.

items.name: Contracts in Liyue
items.notes: Sanctity of contracts under the God of Contracts; 'those who break contracts shall suffer the wrath of the Rock'. No standalone wiki page.

items.name: Religion in Liyue
items.notes: Rex Lapis/Morax worship as God of Contracts, adepti reverence, Rite of Descension/Parting, post-Ch.I 'Age of Humans'. Contract sanctity covered in culture.liyue-contracts.

items.name: Ludi Harpastum
items.notes: 15-day festival of games, songs, wine; champion's maiden throws the Harpastum ball. One of Mondstadt's oldest festivals; tied to Barbatos teaching wine-brewing. Not to be confused with the 'Harpastum' exploration mechanic.

items.name: Religion in Mondstadt
items.notes: Faith in Barbatos as practised via the Church of Favonius (faction entry separate); hymns, Statue of the Seven, Holy Lyre der Himmel; Barbatos's absentee 'god of freedom' stance.

items.name: Moon-Prayer Night
items.notes: Aka Kuunrukous; Nod-Krai's liveliest festival, held on the night the moon is closest; kuuvahki peaks, Moonveils hung in Nasha Town. Started by the Frostmoon Scions celebrating the Moon Goddess. Introduced in Luna I.

items.name: Moonchase Festival
items.notes: Liyue mid-autumn style family reunion festival.

items.name: Religion in Natlan
items.notes: Pyro Archon reverence, Sacred Flame, Ancient Names, ancestral spirits / Night Kingdom beliefs, tribal Wayob/saurian relations.

items.name: Moon Goddess Faith of Nod-Krai
items.notes: Frostmoon Scions' faith in the Moon Goddess (Frost Moon), Kuutar/Columbina's role, Moonchanter (Lauma); ties to Moon-Prayer Night. Faction entry separate.

items.name: Rite of Descension
items.notes: Annual ceremony where the Qixing invited Rex Lapis to give yearly predictions; staged scene of 'Rex Lapis's death' in Prologue/Ch.I. Wiki page 'Rite of Descension' is the quest; lore lives in Liyue/Culture section.

items.name: Sabzeruz Festival
items.notes: Festival honoring Lesser Lord Kusanali's birth; central to the 3.0 Archon Quest Samsara loop (Nilou's dance). Mentioned since 1.4.

items.name: Religion in Sumeru
items.notes: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata veneration vs. neglect of Lesser Lord Kusanali; desert reverence for King Deshret; Akademiya's rationalist stance on faith.

items.name: Akademiya Extravaganza
items.notes: Annual Wisdom Gala + quadrennial Interdarshan Championship (Diadem of Knowledge).

items.name: Exorcists and Thaumaturges
items.notes: Liyue exorcist tradition (Chongyun, Shenhe's teachers); thaumaturge redirects here. Also Inazuman onmyouji-style practice.

items.name: Fontaine Cuisine
items.notes: French-inspired haute cuisine, Fonta soda, Hotel Debord; Escoffier's culinary prominence.

items.name: Daily Life in Fontaine
items.notes: Arkhium/pneumousia technology, aquabus, The Steambird press, mystery novels, language of flowers, Fleuve Cendre class divide.

items.name: Fontaine Performing Arts
items.notes: Theatre, opera, cinema (Fontinalia Film Festival), magic shows (Lyney), mystery novels.

items.name: Hilichurlian
items.notes: Hilichurl language and lexicon. | Hilichurl language with lexicon subpage (Hilichurlian/Lexicon); relevant to Khaenri'ah curse lore.

items.name: Inazuma Cuisine
items.notes: Japanese-inspired cuisine (dango, ramen, udon, sakura mochi), Kiminami Restaurant, sake.

items.name: Daily Life in Inazuma
items.notes: Sakoku era, Tri-Commission bureaucracy, duels, ikebana, light novels (Yae Publishing House), clans.

items.name: Irodori Festival
items.notes: Inazuman arts festival (poetry, ikebana, painting); 2.6 and 3.4 events.

items.name: Daily Life in Khaenri'ah
items.notes: Historical: agriculture, architecture, education, entertainment, technology, Eclipse Dynasty fashion and four/eight-pointed star symbols.

items.name: Krsnik Noc
items.notes: Snezhnayan festival (CN 'Ice Hearth Festival'); only Ivanovich's comparison to Lantern Rite is known; wiki has no 7.x expansion.

items.name: Liyue Cuisine
items.notes: Chinese-inspired cuisine; Wanmin Restaurant, Xiangling, Liuli Pavilion, Xinyue Kiosk; tea culture.

items.name: Daily Life in Liyue
items.notes: Commerce-driven harbor life, medicine, technology, sword/mystic arts, Qixing governance.

items.name: Liyue Opera
items.notes: Traditional Liyue opera; Yun Jin and the Yun-Han Opera Troupe; Zhongli's fondness for opera.

items.name: Mikawa Flower Festival
items.notes: 500+ year old youkai festival attended by Ei, Makoto, Kitsune Saiguu, Yae Miko; revived in present day (Akitsu Yuugei).

items.name: Mondstadt Cuisine
items.notes: Hash brown, grilled fish, Sweet Madame, Moon Pie; dairy/apples; wine culture (Dandelion Wine, Dawn Winery, Angel's Share).

items.name: Daily Life in Mondstadt
items.notes: Agriculture, architecture, education, economy, politics (Knights rule, former aristocracy), ethos of freedom.

items.name: Naming Conventions of Teyvat
items.notes: Per-nation real-world naming bases: Mondstadt (German/English), Liyue (Chinese), Inazuma (Japanese, family-name-first), Sumeru (Persian/Arabic/Indian), Fontaine (French), Natlan (Mesoamerican/African/Andean/Polynesian; Ancient Names), Snezhnaya (Russian patronymics), Nod-Krai (Finnish/Slavic). Synthesized; no single wiki page.

items.name: Natlan Cuisine
items.notes: Mesoamerican/African/Latin-inspired: tatacos, xocoatl, grainfruit, saurus crackers, volcano cake.

items.name: Daily Life in Natlan
items.notes: Tribal society, saurian companionship, phlogiston technology, martial/competitive ethos, Easybreeze resort.

items.name: Tribal Society of Natlan
items.notes: Six current tribes and defunct ones, tribal reputation, Heroes of Natlan; individual tribes are faction entries.

items.name: Daily Life in Nod-Krai
items.notes: Frontier life under kuuvahki, Lightkeepers vs Wild Hunt, Frostmoon Scions, Nasha Town, Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. No Nod-Krai/Culture page exists.

items.name: Rite of Parting
items.notes: Liyue funeral rite for deceased adepti/Archon (Zhongli's in Ch.I). Liyue funerary customs (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) can be folded in.

items.name: Snezhnaya Cuisine
items.notes: Slavic-inspired: borscht, pierogi, rye instead of wheat, smetana, Fire-Water liquor, shashliks, stroganina, medovik, okroshka (7.0 dishes).

items.name: Daily Life in Snezhnaya
items.notes: Cold climate, Kresnik's Torch, public trains, Snezhnograd Veche politics, Fatui-dominated state; 7.0/7.1 content is thin on wiki.

items.name: Religion in Snezhnaya
items.notes: Devotion to the Tsaritsa (Anastasya) and memory of the Belyi Tsar / Snowland Fae era. Wiki culture page has no dedicated Religion section; content needs per-quest verification (7.0-7.1).

items.name: Snezhnayan Ballet and Theater
items.notes: Korolevskiy Troupe in Snezhnograd (prima ballerina Odette, prima donna Vodyanitsa), Korolevskiy Theater, Polestar Ballet Anthology; popular with Harbingers.

items.name: Sumeru Cuisine
items.notes: South Asian/Middle Eastern-inspired: biryani, samosa, Padisarah pudding; Lambad's Tavern, Puspa Cafe; spices.

items.name: Daily Life in Sumeru
items.notes: Akademiya education/Akasha reliance, ban on dreaming/arts under old Sages, rainforest vs desert, families and lineages.

items.name: Summer Festival
items.notes: Narukami Island summer festival with the Naganohara Fireworks Show (Yoimiya, 'Queen of the Summer Festival'); fold Naganohara Fireworks Show in here.

items.name: Teyvat Script and Common Tongue
items.notes: Common tongue/writing used across nations (Mondstadt-style). 'Teyvat Language' redirects here.

items.name: Weinlesefest
items.notes: Autumn wine-harvest festival; new wine sealed until Windcoming Day and uncasked to invite the Anemo Archon. Event: Of Ballads and Brews (3.1).

items.name: Ancient Teyvat Script
items.notes: Ancient script (Khaenri'ah/old ruins); verify association.

items.name: Deshret Script
items.notes: Ancient desert civilization script.

items.name: Eight Adepts
items.notes: Liyue Culture-category legend introduced with the 5.3 Lantern Rite; companion 'Seven-and-Eight-Gates Method' page also exists.

items.name: Fontaine Fashion
items.notes: Belle Epoque styles, Gardes, Spina di Rosula, Meropide, Melusine fashion; Chiori's boutique.

items.name: Fontaine Fashion Week
items.notes: Recurring social/fashion event; Chiori dislikes it.

items.name: Fontaine Script
items.notes: French-inspired language ('c'est la vie').

items.name: Genius Invokation TCG
items.notes: In-world popular card game originating from Fontaine (mentioned 2.3, playable 3.3); Cat's Tail tavern.

items.name: Goshintou Ceremony
items.notes: Swordsmiths offer masterwork swords (Goshintou) to the Grand Narukami Shrine honoring the Shogun bringing sword-making to Inazuma. No standalone page.

items.name: Hot Pot Game
items.notes: Minor custom; low value.

items.name: Hyakkiyakou
items.notes: Listed under Inazuma/Culture 'Festivals and Holidays'; youkai/night-parade tradition (Hyakkiyakou Illuminated story).

items.name: Inazuman Arts
items.notes: Ikebana, light novels, poetry (Five Kasen), martial arts and bladesmithing (Raiden Gokaden).

items.name: Duels in Inazuma
items.notes: Inazuma/Culture 'Duels' section; Vision Hunt duels, Duel Before the Throne.

items.name: Inazuma Fashion
items.notes: Kimono-styled dress, samurai, Shogun's Army/Watatsumi uniforms, shrine maiden attire, mon crests.

items.name: Inazuman Script
items.notes: Plus Ishine Script (Enkanomiya/Watatsumi) and tanuki language.

items.name: Iridescence Tour
items.notes: International music tour originating in Fontaine (organizer Dvorak); Lantern Rite Grand Concert with Xinyan/Hu Tao.

items.name: Liyue Fashion
items.notes: Millelith uniform, Wangsheng uniforms, exorcist attire.

items.name: Liyue Script
items.notes: Also Adeptus script; Liyue idioms on Liyue/Culture.

items.name: Martial Arts in Teyvat
items.notes: Sword/polearm schools (Guhua, Raiden Gokaden etc.).

items.name: Medicine in Teyvat
items.notes: Doctors, pharmacies (Bubu Pharmacy), Sumeru medicine, Melusine nurses.

items.name: Bards and Music of Mondstadt
items.notes: Bardic tradition (Venti), ballads, Holy Lyre; Mondstadt as 'City of Songs and Wine'. No standalone page.

items.name: Mondstadt Fashion
items.notes: Men's/women's fashion, bards, maids, Church habits, Knights uniforms.

items.name: Natlan Fashion
items.notes: Per-tribe dress (Children of Echoes, Scions of the Canopy, People of the Springs, Flower-Feather Clan, Masters of the Night-Wind, Collective of Plenty).

items.name: Nod-Krai Cuisine
items.notes: Nordic/Slavic frontier food: lohikeitto, krumkakes/lakkaberry dishes, Nod-Krai Hot Dog. No dedicated culture page (Nod-Krai/Culture missing); built from dish pages.

items.name: Snezhnaya and Nod-Krai Fashion
items.notes: Fatui uniforms, bounty hunters, Frostmoon Scions clothing, Lightkeeper uniforms (Nod-Krai covered on same wiki page).

items.name: Snezhnayan Script
items.notes: Used in Snezhnaya and Nod-Krai.

items.name: Education in Sumeru
items.notes: Six Darshans, theses, Akasha terminals, Matra enforcement of academic rules.

items.name: Sumeru Fashion
items.notes: Akademiya uniforms per Darshan, Forest Ranger, Eremite, Corps of Thirty attire.

items.name: Symbols in Teyvat
items.notes: Recurring motifs/heraldry across nations.

items.name: Unu
items.notes: The hilichurls' holy word for god and the origin of life.

items.name: Vestnik
items.notes: Snezhnaya Vestnik newspaper sold at train-station stands; articles subpage.

items.name: Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition
items.notes: Traditional swordsmanship exhibition; champions once faced the Shogun. Inazuma duel culture can be folded in.

items.name: Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri
items.notes: Watatsumi Island festival (Mitama Omatsuri redirects here); linked to Orobashi worship.
